claims.summary: Nesset y Janda (2023) analizan adjetivos predicativos con cópula cero en el subcorpus sintáctico del Russian National Corpus; informan 89 % de formas cortas en el conjunto y 67 % en el espacio de competencia, donde ambas formas varían.

locator.section: Sección o pasaje de la fuente primaria
locator.lines: Abstract; sections 1 and 6, conclusion; article lines 41–42, 89, 515–520
locator.exactCoverage: The study uses the syntactic subcorpus of the Russian National Corpus and limits its analysis to predicate adjectives with zero copula. It reports short forms as 89% of the dataset overall and 67% within the competition space; it describes variation and modest predictors there.
